# BulkyMailer — Best & Most Stable Free Email Marketing Platform

> BulkyMailer is a modern, high-deliverability email marketing SaaS platform built for startups, developers, and creators. It offers a 100% free tier with 100 emails/month, custom domain deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment), a visual drag-and-drop template editor, and real-time campaign analytics.

## Core Features & Capabilities

- **100% Free Plan**: Send up to 100 emails per month with zero credit card required.
- **High Deliverability**: Powered by Resend infrastructure with verified custom domain support (SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment).
- **Visual Email Builder**: Drag-and-drop template builder with live device previews (Desktop, Mobile, Inbox) and direct text editing.
- **Real-Time Analytics**: Track opens, clicks, unique engagement rates, device breakdowns, and delivery logs in real time.
- **Contact Management**: Drag-and-drop CSV list imports, merge tags (`{{firstName}}`, `{{company}}`), and bounce detection.
- **AI-Powered Assistance**: Integrated Gemini 2.5 AI assistant for automatic email template generation and copywriting optimization.
- **Developer API & Webhooks**: Programmatically dispatch emails and ingest real-time delivery webhooks.
